paragraphs: I am an electrical engineering student at the University of Oklahoma, working on analog and mixed-signal integrated circuit design and silicon photonics. Most of what I build lives on the SkyWater sky130 open PDK, which means I can publish the schematics, netlists and layouts in full rather than describing them from a distance.

This site documents my electronics and IC design projects. Each one covers the design flow, the specification it had to meet, the results, and what I would do differently. The About page has my skills, coursework, and timeline. The data behind each project is downloadable, and my resume and contact details are at the top.
